capabilities: Collect highlights and comments into a searchable sidebar
Add and manage tasks with natural-language quick add
Sync dated tasks to external calendars with reminders
Jump from sidebar entries to their location in notes
extras: Freemium: everything except calendar sync is free; calendar sync requires a paid Power-Up subscription sold through Polar, with license validation against the author's server. The plugin sends nothing online until a license key is entered or a calendar connected, and has no analytics. Available in English and Simplified Chinese; PDF highlights are not supported.
problem: Highlights, footnotes and checkboxes are scattered across notes in a vault, with no single place to browse, search and navigate them.

relations.evidence: Including the inline-style and CSS-class output of Highlightr
Metadata written by the Tasks plugin is hidden by default
the same one that runs Describe in Oriko
Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud, or any other CalDAV calendar

requires.name: Google, Microsoft or iCloud account (calendar sync)

summary: Sidebar that collects highlights, comments and tasks from across a vault, with search, filters, collections, natural-language quick add and calendar sync.
